title: My God, why?
framework: Psalm 22 — Lament heard from the cross

panels.heading: TODAY’S PASSAGE
panels.content:
**Psalm 22**

This devotional is being drafted. The full reading + reflection ships in a future writing pass.

In the meantime, open your Bible to Psalm 22 and read it slowly. Sit with one phrase that catches you. Bring it back to mind tomorrow.

panels.heading: WHY THIS PASSAGE
panels.content:
Today’s pivot: Lament heard from the cross. The whole canon points forward — and this reading carries its own thread of that long pointing.

Christ-link: Christ quoted this from the cross (Mark 15:34).

panels.heading: A PRAYER
panels.content: Father, when I read this passage, let me see You truly. Slow my hurry. Soften my certainty. Show me what I have missed. Through Christ, who is the substance of every shadow. Amen.
